name: Qwik
title: qwik.dev
shortDescription: Qwik is a modern web development framework designed to deliver instantly-interactive web applications at scale. It leverages a unique approach that skips traditional hydration, enabling applications to become interactive without the usual delay. This makes Qwik an excellent choice for developers familiar with React, as it builds on similar concepts like JSX and functional components but optimizes them for better performance. Ideal for projects requiring high performance and scalability, such as dynamic eCommerce platforms or complex SaaS applications.
cons: Limited community support compared to older frameworks
Potential over-reliance on specific technologies like Vite and Vitest
